pages.text: "All in one bite!" Lulu took a huge bite of olive bread dipped in soup. Steam rose over the autumn table. Without chewing once, Lulu swallowed.
"This is faster!" Another big bite, another gulp. Bread filled the cheeks to bursting.
"Hic! Hic!" Lulu pressed both hands to the tummy, shoulders bobbing. Hurried swallowing without chewing brought endless hiccups. With each hiccup, Lulu bounced, eyes filling with tears.
Mom offered water and rubbed Lulu's back with her other forepaw. Lulu took the cup in both forepaws. After a drink, the hiccups slowly stopped. Uncle Beppo sat beside Lulu, walking stick in hand.
"In our day, we ate to a beat." Uncle Beppo tapped the floor with his stick. "One tap, one good chew."
"Ten taps make the bread soft." Lulu tore off a small bite. "I will count all ten!" Both eyes shone.
Tap, tap, tap... Ten stick taps, ten chews. A rich flavor spread. "Bread tastes like this? Ten taps, ten chews!"
Eating slowly left the tummy comfortable. No hiccups now. Lulu nodded, and the blue bell jingled.
Lulu tapped the table with a blunt hand. "One, tear off a small bite! Two, ten taps, ten chews! Three, swallow after chewing!" Uncle Beppo kept the beat with his stick.
Uncle Beppo hugged Lulu's shoulders. Count ten taps while chewing for tasty food and a comfortable tummy. "Now our Lulu counts taps while eating. Ten taps, ten chews!"
